ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify lesions and systems can verify certificates, but inspectors must still notice when an animal appears unwell or meat has abnormal color and accept responsibility for the final signature.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 14,700 agricultural inspectors employed in 2024, rising to a projected 14,900 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 200 jobs and about 2,200 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $51,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace agricultural inspectors, but it will change how they work. Image recognition, electronic certificates, and digital traceability increasingly handle data and document verification, shifting inspectors from checking ledgers toward on-site judgment, sampling, enforcement, and quality control. Sensory judgment and legal accountability remain difficult to automate. Inspectors who understand testing technology and digital tools become more resilient.
ai_s2_accel: AI image recognition supports disease identification
Smart grading scans for hog carcasses
Expansion of blockchain traceability platforms
Widespread mobile enforcement and data platforms
ai_s2_auto: Automated verification of electronic certificates and ledgers
Data integration with agricultural product traceability systems
ai_s3_list: On-site sensory judgment: notice animal condition and carcass color beyond machine signals.
Quarantine accountability: a signature carries responsibility, and incorrect decisions have serious consequences.
Emergency outbreak response: rapidly identify abnormalities, restrict movement, report, and act.
Command of regulations and procedures: compliant processes create public trust.
Inspection expertise: anatomy, sampling, and interpretation depend on professional skill.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means about half of desk-based work is becoming digital. AI and software assist with certificate checks, ledger records, and report generation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI handles data tasks, leaving on-site sensory judgment, sampling actions, and enforcement more important. Pure recordkeeping roles shrink, while inspectors with technical expertise who accept accountability remain resilient.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study veterinary medicine, food science, or agriculture. Public-institution or civil-service quarantine roles offer a stable path. Build both inspection expertise and regulatory knowledge rather than relying on memorization.

Use AI recognition, digital traceability, and mobile enforcement tools and take responsibility for complex inspections. Progress from recordkeeper to a hybrid inspection and on-site enforcement role, and consider credentials such as licensed veterinarian.

A veterinary medicine or food science background is ideal, but inspection-assistant or corporate quality roles can provide entry. On your resume, specify inspections performed, certificates reviewed, and certification experience.
Do not hire inspectors based only on education. Evaluate on-site judgment and responsibility. Develop younger staff who are willing to learn digital tools into technical leaders.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid pesticide-residue screening for fruits and vegetables
Automated alerts for lesions and abnormalities

ai_s7_trends: AI recognition and digital traceability shift inspectors from ledgers and certificates toward on-site judgment and enforcement, making digital tools standard.
Stricter food-safety regulation sustains demand for inspection and quarantine roles, especially inspectors with technical expertise who accept accountability.
Integrated inspection and traceability platforms shift roles toward a combination of inspection, data, and enforcement, with digital skills required even in local positions.

body: Agricultural inspectors examine and quarantine meat, eggs, produce, and animals and plants entering or leaving a jurisdiction. They conduct slaughter quarantine, on-site sampling, certificate verification, records, and enforcement actions to protect agricultural product quality and public health.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can identify lesions and systems can verify certificates, but inspectors must still notice when an animal appears unwell or meat has abnormal color and accept responsibility for the final signature.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能识别病斑、系统能核验票证，但「这头猪精神不对」「这刀肉颜色发暗」——现场那一眼，加上签字的责任，还得你来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年农业检查员在岗约 1.47 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.49 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.10 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农业检查员，但会改变工作方式。AI 图像识别、电子票证、数字追溯正在接管数据和票证核验，检查员从「跑台账、核单据」转向「现场判断、抽检处置、执法把关」。现场的感官判断和法律责任，是机器替代不了的核心——懂检验技术又会用数字工具的检查员更稳。
ai_s2_accel: AI 图像识别辅助病害判别
生猪胴体智能分级扫描
区块链溯源平台推广
移动执法与数据平台普及
ai_s2_auto: 电子票证与台账自动核验
农产品追溯系统数据对接
检验报告模板自动生成
ai_s3_list: 现场感官判断：精神状态、胴体色泽，机器给不了的那一眼。
检疫责任担当：签字就是担责，判断错了后果严重。
突发疫情处置：发现异常，封锁、上报、处置要快。
法规与流程的把握：程序合规，才有公信力。
检验技术的积累：解剖、取样、判读，靠专业功底。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业约有一半桌面环节正在被数字化——票证核验、台账记录、报告生成，AI 和软件都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接走的是「数据」环节，留下的是「现场」环节——感官判断、抽检处置、执法把关反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯台账岗，懂检验、能担责的检查员更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选动物医学、食品科学或农学专业，报考检疫相关事业编/公务员是稳定路径。把检验技术和法规都练起来，别只会背书。
把 AI 识别、数字追溯和移动执法工具用起来，主动承担复杂检验。从「记录员」升级为「检验技术+现场执法」复合角色，考执业兽医等资格。
有动医或食品背景最好，可从检验机构助理或企业质检切入。简历上多写「做过哪些检验、核过哪些票证、有没有出证经验」。
招检查员别只看学历，要看现场判断和责任心。愿意学数字工具的年轻人，值得培养成技术骨干。

ai_s7_trends: AI 识别与数字追溯普及，检查员从「核台账、跑票证」转向「现场判断、执法把关」，数字工具成为标配。
食品安全监管趋严，检验检疫岗位需求稳定，懂检验技术、能担责的检查员更抢手。
检验数据与溯源平台打通，检查员向「检验+数据+执法」复合角色转变，基层岗位也要求数字化能力。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate load plans quickly and accurately, but only people on the ramp know how to handle three extra tons of cargo and a changed gate time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 10,300 aircraft cargo handling supervisors employed in 2024, rising to a projected 10,800 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 500 jobs and about 1,100 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $63,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace aircraft cargo handling supervisors. Loading organization, staffing, and on-site safety supervision must occur on the ramp, and people must verify final load plans. AI optimizes load calculations and documents, but machines cannot lead a crew in loading an aircraft.
ai_s2_accel: Digital load-planning systems support verification
Automated sorting systems improve efficiency
Smart terminals synchronize progress in real time
AI scheduling optimizes staff and equipment allocation
ai_s2_auto: Digital flight information and cargo manifests
ai_s3_list: On-site organization: coordinate simultaneous work at multiple stands.
Load-plan verification: confirm decisions affecting flight safety.
Staff allocation: adjust teams in real time according to cargo volume.
Exception handling: decide how to manage damage and added cargo.
Safety management: control ramp-operation risks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means AI clearly improves efficiency while people remain central. Systems increasingly handle documents, load calculations, and data records, while ramp scheduling, organization, and safety supervision depend heavily on on-site human capability.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean easy work. Digital load planning and automated sorting reduce lower-skill labor. Supervisors must learn data and systems, upgrading experience-based leadership into data-informed leadership.

ai_s5_persona.建议: People seeking airport careers can study logistics or civil aviation transportation or advance from cargo handling. Ramp conditions are demanding, but airport ground-service systems offer clear advancement and stability.

Master load planning and ramp operations and learn digital scheduling systems. Progress toward cargo operations management or ramp coordination rather than remaining focused only on physical-work organization.

Warehouse, logistics, and site-management backgrounds transfer well. In interviews, describe operations you organized and exceptions you resolved. Airport ground services value process awareness and safety discipline.
Ramp supervisors experience high turnover. Retain them with clear advancement, night-shift premiums, and skill training. Provide enough staff during peak cargo periods so supervisors can succeed.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically calculate cargo-space allocation and weight
Allocate people and equipment in real time
Monitor operating areas in real time
Update flight status in real time

ai_s7_trends: Cross-border e-commerce cargo growth supports demand for aviation ground services.
Digital load planning and automated sorting shift supervisors toward data management.
Cargo-terminal expansion at international hubs sustains management demand.

body: Aircraft cargo handling supervisors organize air-cargo loading and unloading on airport ramps, coordinating crews, equipment, and load verification while supervising safety and deadlines.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate load plans quickly and accurately, but only people on the ramp know how to handle three extra tons of cargo and a changed gate time.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把配载方案算得又快又准，但「临时加了三吨货、机位时间又改了」——这些现场变数怎么摆平，只有蹲在机坪上的人知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年飞机货物装卸主管在岗约 1.03 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.08 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.11 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.39 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代飞机货物装卸主管：装卸组织、人员调配、现场安全监督都必须在机坪实地完成，配载的最终确认也离不开人的复核。AI 能优化配载计算和单证处理，但「带班组把货装上飞机」这件事，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: 数字配载系统辅助复核
自动化分拣系统提升效率
智能终端实时同步作业进度
AI 调度优化人员与设备分配
ai_s2_auto: 航班信息与货单电子化
装卸单证与记录自动生成
计费与统计报表自动化
ai_s3_list: 现场组织：多机位同时作业的统筹。
配载复核：对飞行安全负责的确认。
人员调配：按货量实时调整班组。
异常处置：破损、加货的临场决断。
安全管理：机坪作业的风险把控。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明装卸主管是「AI 明显提效、但核心靠人」的运营岗：单证、配载计算和数据记录被系统大幅接管，而机坪现场的调度组织和安全监督，依然高度依赖人的现场能力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低中分不等于轻松：数字化配载和自动化分拣在压缩低端人力，主管要往上走，得学会看数据、用系统，把「经验带队」升级成「数据带队」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子想进机场体系，可以先从物流、民航运输相关专业读起，或者先当装卸工再往上走。要讲清楚：机坪作业环境辛苦，但机场地服体系晋升路径清晰，稳定是最大优势。
把配载和机坪运行流程吃透，学数字化调度系统。往货运运营管理、机坪运行协调方向走，别停留在纯体力组织层。
有仓储、物流、现场管理背景的容易上手。面试时重点讲你组织过什么现场作业、怎么处理突发情况，机场地服看重的是流程意识和安全素养。
机坪主管流动性高，用「清晰的晋升通道 + 夜班补贴 + 技能培训」留人。旺季货量暴增时给足人力支持，否则再好的主管也难为无米之炊。

ai_s7_trends: 跨境电商货量增长带动航空地服需求。
数字化配载与自动化分拣普及，主管转向数据管理。
国际枢纽机场货站扩容，管理岗需求稳定。

body: 飞机货物装卸主管在机坪组织航空货物装卸作业，统筹班组分工、设备调配与舱位配载核对，监督作业安全和时限，保障航班货舱高效装运。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Process modeling and formulation screening can be accelerated, but managers remain responsible for technology-path decisions and cross-functional choices.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 212,500 biofuels and biodiesel technology and product development managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 220,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,000 jobs, with approximately 14,500 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $167,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace development managers, but it will accelerate process modeling and formulation screening. Models simulate scale-up and recommend pathways, shifting managers from monitoring data toward setting direction and leading teams. Pure analysis faces displacement, while people who make decisions and coordinate effectively become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Technology-path recommendations
Pilot-risk warnings
Portfolio assessment
Cross-functional coordination support
ai_s3_list: Pathway judgment: people make decisions.
Cross-functional coordination: people build alignment.
Regulatory tradeoffs: people apply experience.
Scale-up decisions: people exercise judgment.
Resource allocation: people bear responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in a moderate exposure zone for development work. Modeling and screening are absorbed by systems, while decision-making and coordination still leave an essential role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. Pure analysis faces replacement, not roles that steer technology. People who make decisions and coordinate effectively become scarcer as technology advances, while those limited to producing reports face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in chemical engineering and biology, then develop management and project skills early.
Advance from research and development to managing technology pathways, and build scale-up experience.
Emphasize process and management experience and identify the products you have supported.
When hiring, evaluate decision-making and coordination. People who take responsibility for implementation merit high compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Carbon-reduction goals drive technology pathways.
Process modeling becomes widespread.
Decision-making and coordination become scarcer.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 工艺建模与配方筛选能被加速，但路线判断与跨团队决策，还是经理扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生物燃料/生物柴油技术与产品开发经理在岗约 21.25 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 22.05 万人，净增约 0.80 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.45 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 16.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代开发经理，但会加速工艺建模与配方筛选。模型预放大、荐路线，经理从「盯数据」转向「断方向、管团队」。真正被挤掉的是纯分析，会决策会协调的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 技术路线推荐
中试风险预警
组合方案评估
跨团队协同辅助

跨团队协调：默契靠人。
法规权衡：经验靠人。
放大决策：脑子靠人。
资源排布：责任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的开发区——建模筛选被吃，但决策协调仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「纯分析」，不是「技术掌舵」的岗位。会决策、能协调的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会出报表的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 化工生物打底，早点练管理与项目。
从研发升级成管路线，攒放大经验。
突出工艺与管理，写清跟过哪些产品。
选人看决策与协调，能扛落地的值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 双碳拉动路线。
工艺建模普及。
决策协调更缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can search literature, organize data, and draft course materials, but a teacher still judges why a student's laboratory result looks that way and whether a research topic deserves three years of investment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 66,000 postsecondary biological science teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 70,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,800 jobs, with approximately 5,400 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $83,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary biological science teachers, but it will substantially change how they work. AI accelerates literature reviews, data analysis, course-material generation, and writing support. Teachers shift time from organizing information toward research design, laboratory guidance, and academic judgment, all work grounded in experience and scientific taste that AI cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted protein structure and molecular design
Widespread omics-analysis platforms
Online laboratory simulations expand teaching methods
AI-assisted drafting of research grant applications
ai_s2_auto: AI-assisted literature searches and review organization
Initial experimental-data analysis and chart generation
AI generation of courseware and teaching materials
Automatic formatting of papers and references
ai_s3_list: Research design: judge topics, hypotheses, and experimental paths.
Academic judgment: assess data credibility and the limits of conclusions.
Laboratory guidance: help students troubleshoot hands-on.
Classroom interaction: make complex concepts compelling and understandable.
Long-term planning: coordinate research topics, teams, and students.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means automation concentrates in information and data tasks. AI supports literature, course materials, data, and charts, while research depends on asking good questions and judging whether answers are sound. Those tasks require academic taste and experience, leaving AI in a supporting role.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate risk does not guarantee security. AI reduces the advantage of researchers limited to repetitive experiments and data organization, while amplifying the output of teachers who design and judge well. Using AI as a tool can raise research efficiency several times over.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Think carefully before choosing an academic path. A doctorate is the entry threshold and up-or-out employment is common. Choose it when the family can provide financial support and the student genuinely enjoys research; otherwise, build fundamentals as an undergraduate and use graduate internships to test whether academia fits.

Use AI tools to save time and invest the gains in research design and team development. Track industry directions in biopharmaceuticals and synthetic biology, because external collaboration can bring funding and expand academic influence.

University faculty competition is intense. Start through a postdoctoral or research-assistant role, or build experience in biotechnology research and development before applying to universities. Bring publications and project results to interviews instead of relying on statements of enthusiasm.

Do not evaluate faculty only by publication counts. Include teaching effectiveness, student development, and industry translation. Provide early-career faculty with AI tools and data platforms, and use team collaboration to reduce the pressure of conducting research alone.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Literature search, review, and citation management
Automated analysis of gene and protein data
Protein structure prediction and molecular design
Rapid course-material generation from a syllabus
Statistical analysis and visualization of experimental data

ai_s7_trends: AI-assisted research becomes widespread, shifting teachers from information organization toward research design and judgment.
Biopharmaceutical and synthetic-biology industries increase university demand for biological talent.
Up-or-out employment becomes common, increasing recognition for faculty who perform well in both teaching and research.

body: Postsecondary biological science teachers teach and conduct research in biological sciences at universities and colleges. They teach biology, ecology, cell biology, genetics, and related courses, supervise laboratories and graduate students, and conduct research and publish academic work.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can search literature, organize data, and draft course materials, but a teacher still judges why a student's laboratory result looks that way and whether a research topic deserves three years of investment.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校生物科学教师在岗约 6.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.08 万人，净增约 0.48 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.54 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.35 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校生物科学教师，但会大幅改变工作方式：文献综述、数据分析、课件生成、论文辅助都被 AI 加速。教师的时间从「整理资料」转向「科研设计、实验指导、学术判断」——这些基于经验和品味的工作，AI 替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助蛋白质结构与分子设计
组学数据分析平台普及
在线实验模拟扩展教学手段
科研基金申请书的 AI 辅助撰写

实验数据的初步分析与图表生成
课件与教学素材的 AI 生成
论文格式、参考文献的自动整理
ai_s3_list: 科研设计：选题、假设与实验路径的判断。
学术判断：数据的可信度与结论的边界。
实验指导：手把手带学生排错。
课堂互动：把复杂概念讲到学生眼里有光。
长期规划：课题、团队与学生的统筹。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行的自动化集中在「资料和数据层」：文献、课件、数据图表都能被 AI 辅助，但科研的核心是「提出好问题和判断答案对不对」，这些依赖学术品味和经验，AI 只能打下手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于高枕无忧：AI 会让「只会做重复实验和整理数据」的研究者失去优势，但也会放大「会设计、会判断」的教师的产出；把 AI 当工具用，科研效率是别人的几倍。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走学术路要提前想清楚：博士是门槛，非升即走是常态。家里有经济支持、孩子真喜欢科研再选；否则本科打好基础，硕士阶段先实习验证自己适不适合学术。
把 AI 工具用起来省下时间，精力投在科研设计和团队培养上。盯紧生物医药、合成生物学的产业方向，横向合作能带来经费，也能扩大学术影响力。
高校教职竞争激烈，可以从博士后、科研助理切入，或者先到生物企业研发岗积累，再回高校应聘。求职时带上论文和课题成果，比空谈热爱有用。
考核别只数论文，把「教学效果 + 学生培养 + 产业转化」纳入评价；给青年教师配 AI 工具和数据平台，用团队协作减轻单打独斗的科研压力。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Remote centralized control can let one dispatcher manage several bridges and locks, but slippery decks in storms, jammed equipment, and vessels ignoring signals still require on-site eyes and hands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 2,900 bridge and lock tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 2,800 by 2034, a net decrease of about 100 jobs, with approximately 300 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $58,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and remote automation will not eliminate Bridge And Lock Tenders overnight, but employment is declining as operations concentrate in dispatch centers. On-site roles shift toward monitoring, maintenance, and emergency response, making people with equipment skills more secure.
ai_s2_accel: AI vision identifies water-surface obstacles
Sensors monitor equipment status in real time
Trials of automated vessel-clearance processes
Remote diagnosis of equipment faults
ai_s2_auto: Remote centralized control of bridge and lock operations
ai_s3_list: Clearance timing: experience determines the safest moment when vehicles are on the bridge and vessels are on the water.
Emergency response: stabilize the situation within minutes when equipment jams or a vessel behaves unexpectedly.
Equipment-inspection feel: anomalies are found by listening for sounds, checking oil traces, and feeling temperatures.
Vessel-dispatch communication: voice calls, signals, and gestures must be understood immediately.
Extreme-weather response: maintain navigation and operational safety in strong winds, heavy rain, and fog.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places the occupation in the low-moderate AI-exposure range. Records and dispatch make up a meaningful share of the work and systems are taking them over, while on-site operations and emergency response still require people as roles shift toward centralized remote control and maintenance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Bridge and lock control is a typical remote and automated occupation: on-site staffing decreases while remote dispatch, equipment maintenance, and emergency roles grow. Centralized control replaces repetitive on-site operation, but people who understand equipment and adapt have viable paths.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To enter port and waterway operations, study port and waterway engineering, transportation, or electromechanical systems and monitor public recruitment by relevant authorities. Do not focus only on on-site operation in the AI era; learn electromechanical equipment and remote control because future roles are in dispatch centers and maintenance.

Proactively learn centralized remote control and equipment maintenance, moving toward dispatcher or maintenance roles. On-site jobs are shrinking, so transition early instead of waiting for centralized control to replace the position.

Formal recruitment by port and waterway authorities offers a stable entry route. After joining, build combined dispatch and maintenance skills and watch for inland-waterway dispatch and port-equipment roles.

During remote-control upgrades, retrain existing station staff for dispatch and maintenance first, preserving experienced workers at low cost. Prioritize electromechanical backgrounds and emergency-response ability when hiring newcomers.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Raise a bridge or open a lock with one command
Real-time views of bridge decks and water surfaces
Automatic alerts for foreign objects on the water

ai_s7_trends: Remote centralized bridge and lock control becomes widespread, reducing on-site staffing.
Demand grows for equipment maintenance and remote dispatch roles, favoring people with combined skills.
AI vision and sensors enter bridge and lock operations, shifting people toward monitoring backup and emergency response.

body: Bridge And Lock Tenders control movable bridges and operate navigation locks, coordinate safe vessel passage, record operating data, maintain bridge and lock equipment, and keep waterborne traffic moving in an orderly manner.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 远程集中控制能让一个调度员管好几个桥闸，但暴雨天桥面打滑、设备卡住、有船不按信号来，这种时候还得有现场那双眼睛和那双手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年桥梁与船闸操作员在岗约 0.29 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.28 万人，岗位净减约 0.01 万个，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.85 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 与远程自动化不会让桥闸操作员一夜消失，但岗位在减少——操作越来越集中到调度中心。现场值守转向监控、维护与应急处置，会设备的人才更稳。
ai_s2_accel: AI 视觉识别水面障碍
传感器实时监测设备状态
自动放行流程试点
设备故障远程诊断
ai_s2_auto: 桥闸运行远程集中控制
船舶通行数据自动采集
ai_s3_list: 放行时机判断：桥上有车、水上有船，什么时候动最安全，靠经验。
突发处置：设备卡住、船舶异常，怎么在几分钟内稳住局面。
设备巡检手感：听声音、看油迹、摸温度，异常是查出来的。
与船方调度沟通：喊话、信号、手势，要让对方秒懂。
极端天气应对：大风大雨大雾，怎么保证通航与作业安全。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的记录、调度比重不低，这些正被系统接管；现场操作与突发处置仍需人，岗位在向远程集中与维护转型。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化。桥闸控制是「远程化、自动化」的典型岗位——站点值守会减少，但远程调度、设备维护与应急岗在增加。只做现场重复操作的人会被集中控制替代，懂设备、能转型的反而有出路。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入港航系统，读港航、交通或机电专业，关注港航部门招考。AI 时代别只盯「现场操作」，把机电设备、远程控制学起来——未来的岗位在调度中心和维护端。
主动学远程集中控制与设备维护，往调度员、设备维护工方向转。站点岗位在收缩，早转型早占位，别等着被集中控制顶掉。
港航系统招考是正规入口，适合求稳的人。入行后把目标放在「调度加维护」复合能力上，同时留意内河航运调度、港口设备岗位。
桥闸远程化改造时，把原站点人员优先培训转岗到调度与维护，留人成本低、稳定性好。招聘新人也优先看机电背景与应急处理能力。

ai_s7_trends: 桥闸远程集中控制普及，站点值守岗位减少。
设备维护与远程调度岗需求增长，复合技能人才更稳。
AI 视觉与传感器进桥闸，人工转向监控兜底与应急。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Software can generate drawings automatically, but Drafters still decide what to show, how to meet standards, and how each discipline fits together.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 110,500 Architectural And Civil Drafters were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 115,100 by 2034. That represents about 4,600 additional jobs and roughly 10,000 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $64,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace knowledgeable Architectural And Civil Drafters, but it will reduce entry-level roles. Parametric tools and BIM automate repetitive drawing, shifting the work from drafting toward standards, coordination, and quality control. Tracing-only work faces displacement, while people who coordinate disciplines and catch errors gain value.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent standards checks
Automated drawing review
Automated quantity calculations
Version-difference comparison
ai_s3_list: Standards judgment: people must understand the codes.
Discipline coordination: people resolve conflicts.
Design intent: people interpret the concept.
Quality control: people catch omissions and errors.
Site coordination: experience guides the response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places Architectural And Civil Drafters in the moderate-high AI exposure range. Systems accelerate drawing production, while standards and coordination preserve an important human role.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces tracing, not jobs that require standards knowledge and coordination. Drafters who coordinate disciplines and catch errors become scarcer as productivity rises. Tracing-only skills create the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Engineering and civil students should practice BIM early. Tracing-only roles are shrinking, so build standards knowledge from the start.
Move from tracing into coordination and quality control, and learn BIM and applicable standards.
Highlight software and project experience, including the disciplines coordinated on each project.
Do not evaluate candidates only by drawing speed. Check their knowledge of standards. Coordinators who understand the work justify higher compensation.

ai_s7_trends: BIM adoption reduces entry-level roles.
Standards checks become automated.
Experienced coordinators are in greater demand.

body: Architectural And Civil Drafters use CAD and BIM to convert architectural and civil designs into construction drawings with dimensions, materials, and code annotations. They coordinate across disciplines to support construction.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Software can generate drawings automatically, but Drafters still decide what to show, how to meet standards, and how each discipline fits together.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 出图软件能自动生成，但哪些该画、怎么对规范、各专业怎么咬合，还是制图定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年建筑与土木制图员在岗约 11.05 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 11.51 万人，净增约 0.46 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.00 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.43 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代懂行的制图员，但会压缩初级岗。参数化与 BIM 把重复绘图自动化，制图从「画图」挪向「懂规范、管协调、控质量」。真正被挤掉的是只描图的，会协调能控错的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 规范智能核查
图纸自动校审
工程量自动算
版本差异比对
ai_s3_list: 规范判断：标准靠人懂。
专业协调：冲突靠人消。
设计意图：理解靠人。
质量把关：错漏靠人。
现场对接：经验靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的制图区——出图被系统加速，但规范与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「描图」动作，不是「懂规范会协调」的岗位。有协调能力、能控错的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会照描。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 工程/土木起步多练 BIM，AI 时代纯描图在缩，早点练规范。
从「描图」升级成「管协调 + 控质量」，学 BIM 与规范。
突出软件与项目经验，写清跟过哪些专业。
选人别只看软件快，要看懂不懂规范。能协调的骨干值得给溢价。

ai_s7_trends: BIM 普及，初级岗缩。
规范核查自动化。
懂协调的骨干更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can draft slides and literature reviews, but teachers still create the energy in a classroom and make real-time judgments in a laboratory.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, about 9,000 Environmental Science Teachers, Postsecondary were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 9,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 300 jobs, with about 700 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $87,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Environmental Science Teachers, Postsecondary, but it will reshape the early stages of teaching and research. It increasingly handles slide drafts, literature reviews, grading, and data analysis, which consume much of a teacher's desk time. Teachers can invest the saved time in live instruction, laboratory guidance, research design, and industry service. Human judgment remains essential for making knowledge meaningful to students and guiding research toward results.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted research-topic selection and literature mapping
Teaching environmental monitoring with remote sensing and models
Intelligent experiment-design assistance for student plans
Developing online courses and virtual simulation laboratories
ai_s2_auto: Grading assignments and providing learning feedback
Basic statistical processing of experimental data
ai_s3_list: Classroom presence: observe student responses and adjust the pace in real time.
Laboratory and field guidance: solve equipment, safety, and anomalous-data problems on site.
Research judgment: assess topic value, data credibility, and the rigor of conclusions.
Academic ethics and integrity: prevent AI ghostwriting and fabricated data.
Academic mentorship: guide research directions and help students build professional networks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure because this career includes substantial desk work. Lesson planning, literature reviews, grading, and statistics are all well suited to AI.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI drives lesson-preparation costs down and makes teaching quality and research direction more visible. It pressures roles based on reading slides, while teachers who design project-based classes and guide research results enter performance reviews with stronger evidence.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Plan for a long path from bachelor's degree through master's degree, doctorate, and postdoctoral work. Build writing and data-analysis skills, join substantive research projects, and keep environmental-industry roles as an alternative instead of treating a university position as the only outcome.

Use AI as an assistant for lesson preparation and grading, then invest the saved time in laboratory guidance and research design. Adopt virtual simulation, remote-sensing instruction, and other new methods because teaching innovation strengthens performance reviews.

Environmental science doctorate holders should apply beyond universities. Environmental design institutes, consultancies, and corporate ESG teams also recruit them. Present teaching, research, and industry projects together instead of discussing publications alone.

Hiring and reviews should measure teaching outcomes, student feedback, and service results, not only publication counts. Give teachers AI lesson-planning and laboratory tools so they can focus on higher-value teaching and research.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Move hazardous or expensive experiments online
Massive open online courses and flipped classrooms
Analyze assignments and identify learning gaps

ai_s7_trends: AI is becoming infrastructure for lesson preparation and research, making methodological innovation a key differentiator among teachers.
Carbon-reduction and environmental-governance demand is expanding, supporting enrollment and funding in environmental science.
Environmental courses increasingly combine virtual simulations with field practice.

body: Environmental Science Teachers, Postsecondary teach environmental science, ecology, pollution control, and related subjects at universities and vocational colleges. ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 课件和文献综述交给 AI，但课堂上的「化学反应」和实验里的临场判断，还得老师本人来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校环境科学教师在岗约 0.90 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.93 万人，净增约 0.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校环境科学教师，但会重塑备课和科研的前半段：课件初稿、文献综述、批改作业、数据分析——这些占老师大量时间的案头活，AI 正在全面接手。省出来的时间该投到哪里？现场教学、实验指导、课题设计和行业服务。真正替代不了的，是把知识讲到学生心里、把研究方向带出成果的判断力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助科研选题与文献地图
遥感与模型结合的环境监测教学
智能实验设计辅助学生方案优化
在线课程与虚拟仿真实验建设
ai_s2_auto: 课件与讲义的初稿生成
实验数据的基础统计处理
ai_s3_list: 课堂教学现场感：观察学生状态、即时调整讲授节奏。
实验与野外指导：现场解决设备、安全、异常数据问题。
科研判断：选题价值、数据可信度、结论严谨性把关。
学术伦理与诚信：杜绝 AI 代写与数据造假。
师生传承：研究方向的带教与学术人脉的构建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业的案头比例高——备课、文献、批改、统计，全是 AI 的主场，接触面确实不低。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：AI 让「备课成本」趋近于零，反而把「讲得好不好、研究方向对不对」推到台前。被挤压的是照本宣科、只会念 PPT 的教学岗；会设计项目式课堂、能带出成果的教师，在聘期考核里更有底气。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这条路就按「本科—硕—博—博后」长线规划，别只盯热门。在校就练好写作与数据分析，跟导师做真课题；同时把环保产业方向当备选，别把「留高校」当成唯一出路。
把 AI 用成「备课和批改的助手」，把时间省给实验指导与课题设计。主动拥抱虚拟仿真、遥感教学等新手段，聘期考核里「教学方法创新」是实打实的加分项。
环境科学博士求职别只投高校，环保设计院、环境咨询、企业 ESG 岗也在抢人。面试时把「教学 + 科研 + 产业项目」打包讲，比单讲论文更有竞争力。
招聘与考核别再只数论文，要把教学效果、学生反馈、服务成果纳入权重。给老师配 AI 备课与实验工具，能把他们从案头解放到真正值钱的教学与科研上。

Career changers with a sales or service background can get started quickly and focus on acquiring customers and renewing contracts in the early stage. On your resume, write more hard indicators such as "number of customers served, renewal rate, and referral ratio." Don't just write down the amount of performance.

Don't just look at eloquence when recruiting and selling, but also look at demand analysis capabilities and customer management ideas. People who can use AI tools to quickly come up with solutions and explain complex needs thoroughly have a much higher retention rate than those who can only memorize words.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robotic loading and unloading have arrived. Will operators lose their jobs? Roles are declining, but people who can set up machines are becoming more valuable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 177,100 CNC machine-tool operators employed in 2024, projected to decline to 158,100 by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 19,000 jobs, with roughly 13,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $50,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI affects CNC machine operators mainly through automation-driven staffing reductions. Robotic loading and unloading, automatic measurement, and AGV transport clearly reduce the number of operators a workshop needs. Previously, one person managed one machine; now one person manages several, and in the future one person could oversee an entire automated line. Yet as long as machine tools keep running, people must handle alarms, interpret abnormal sounds, and assure qualified parts. These trusted human operators cannot be replaced in the short term.
ai_s2_accel: Pilot lights-out production lines reduce operator roles
AI identifies machining abnormalities and issues automatic alerts
Adaptive machining adjusts parameters automatically

ai_s3_list: Alarm and exception judgment: understand machine behavior and causes behind abnormal sounds and chatter marks.
Machine-setup ability: adjust the first piece after product or tool changes.
Measurement and quality control: determine inspection timing and assess abnormalities.
Multi-machine coordination: prioritize several machines that fail simultaneously.
On-site responsibility: part quality directly connects machine tools with processes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means automation is gradually taking over workholding, measurement, loading, and unloading, while operators still spend substantial time on site. Exposure is medium-low but follows a clear trend.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A low score does not mean safety. Automation, rather than AI alone, replaces operator roles through gradual staffing reductions. The response is clear: move beyond pure operation and learn machine setup, measurement, inspection, and programming. Managing multiple machines or an entire line shifts a worker's value from replaceable to essential.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study CNC machining or smart manufacturing, prioritizing practical work over theory. Practice tool setting, machine setup, measurement, and inspection in school. Join a highly automated company after graduation and advance from operator toward setup and programming instead of remaining in pure operation.

Add machine setup and programming skills and volunteer to learn robotic loading and automated-line operation. Operators who manage multiple machines and understand production lines are among the last retained during staffing reductions.

Starting as an apprentice after technical school or short-term training is viable, but maintain a development plan. In applications, emphasize machine setup, alarm handling, and measurement and inspection, not simply machine-tool operation.

Hire operators with automation trends in mind. Prioritize people with setup potential and willingness to learn and provide automated-line training. Developing experienced operators into line managers retains core staff better than repeatedly hiring beginners.

Managing multiple machines becomes routine, creating clear premiums for operators who run automated lines.

body: CNC machine-tool operators run CNC lathes, mills, machining centers, and related equipment to produce parts. They perform workholding and tool setting, start and monitor operations, measure dimensions, and make simple adjustments to assure timely, qualified batch production.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Robotic loading and unloading have arrived. Will operators lose their jobs? Roles are declining, but people who can set up machines are becoming more valuable.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器人上下料来了，操作员会失业吗？岗位在变少，但会调机的人更值钱了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年数控机床操作员在岗约 17.71 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 15.81 万人，岗位净减约 1.90 万个，年均产生约 1.35 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.00 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 对数控机床操作员的冲击主要体现在「自动化减员」：机器人上下料、自动测量、AGV 搬运，让一个车间需要的操作员数量明显下降——以前一人一机，现在一人多机，未来可能一人管整条自动化产线。但机床还在转，就需要有人在现场处理报警、判断异响、保证零件合格，这些「机器信任的人」短期内替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 无人化产线试点减少操作岗
AI 识别加工异常并自动预警
自适应加工自动调整参数
数字孪生远程监控多台机床
ai_s2_auto: 生产数据自动采集上报
ai_s3_list: 报警与异常判断：机床脾气、异响、振纹背后的原因。
调机能力：换品种、换刀具后的首件调整。
测量与质量控制：抽检的节奏与异常判断。
多机协同：几台机床同时出问题的优先级处理。
现场责任感：零件质量直接连着机床与工艺。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明装夹、测量、上下料这些动作正被自动化逐步接手，但操作员的大量时间仍在现场，属于「中等偏低、但趋势明确」的曝光。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低分不等于安全：操作岗的替代不靠 AI 靠「自动化」，减员是渐进的。应对方法很明确——别停在纯操作层，把调机、量检、编程学起来，一人多机甚至管产线，岗位价值就从「可替代」变成「刚需」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读数控或智能制造专业，实操比理论重要。在校多练对刀、调机、量检，毕业进自动化程度高的企业，从操作员起步往调机与编程走，别停在纯操作。
把调机和编程补上，主动申请学机器人上下料与自动化产线操作。一人多机、会管产线的操作员，在企业减员时是最后被留下的那一批。
技校或短期培训后从学徒做起可以，但要有成长计划。求职时强调「会调机、能处理报警、会量检」，比只写「会操作机床」强得多。
招操作员要看清自动化趋势：优先招有调机潜力和学习意愿的人，配套自动化产线培训。与其反复招新人，不如把老操作员培养成产线管理者。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化上下料与在线测量普及，纯操作岗持续减员。
操作员向「产线管理员」转型，调机与编程能力成为门槛。
一人多机常态化，会管自动化产线的操作员溢价明显。

body: 数控机床操作员负责操作数控车、铣、加工中心等机床完成零件加工：执行装夹对刀、启动运行、过程监控、尺寸测量与简单调整，保障批量零件按时按质产出。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A diagnostic scanner can read a fault code in seconds, but an experienced mechanic still has to feel whether a hydraulic line is leaking and listen for whether a noise sounds right.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 188,700 mobile heavy equipment mechanics were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 199,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 10,900 jobs, with approximately 16,500 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $64,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace heavy equipment mechanics, but it will assist diagnosis. Diagnostic scanners, remote code reading, and repair knowledge bases speed up routine troubleshooting, shifting mechanics from finding faults to repairing complex hydraulic and electronic control systems, handling field emergencies, and training apprentices. Entry-level workers who only replace parts face the greatest pressure, while people who understand electronic controls and can exercise sound judgment are more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Remote code reading for preliminary fault diagnosis
Intelligent search of hydraulic diagrams
Structured repair records
Simulated disassembly and assembly for training
ai_s2_auto: Automated fault-code reading with diagnostic scanners
Repair knowledge bases that recommend solutions
ai_s3_list: Complex hydraulic diagnosis: depends on experience.
Field emergency repairs: depend on adaptability.
Hands-on feel for assembly and disassembly: comes from practice.
Identifying abnormal sounds: depends on a trained ear.
Training and quality oversight: depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in a moderate-high exposure area for hands-on work. Diagnosis is assisted, but disassembly, emergency repair, and experience-based judgment remain firmly in human hands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure still brings change. Routine code reading and maintenance reminders are accelerated, but field emergency response and complex hydraulic repair roles are not. Mechanics with electronic-control diagnostic skills who can handle problems on site are more secure. Entry-level workers who only replace parts and do not understand circuits face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study construction equipment or automotive repair in vocational high school, and gain extensive practice with diagnostic scanners and circuits. Purely mechanical work is shrinking in the AI era, so add electronic-control skills early.
Advance from replacing parts to reading codes and repairing electronic controls. Learn diagnostic software and work toward becoming a service-center manager or training apprentices.
Highlight the equipment models you have repaired and whether you can use diagnostic scanners. Equipment dealers value reliability and the ability to handle projects.
When hiring, look beyond physical strength and assess the ability to read codes and repair electronic controls. Experienced mechanics who can handle field emergencies deserve high incentive pay.

ai_s7_trends: As equipment becomes more electronic, electronic-control repair skills are increasingly valuable.
Remote diagnosis and knowledge bases are becoming widespread.
Versatile mechanics who understand hydraulics and electronic controls have more stable prospects.

body: Mobile Heavy Equipment Mechanics, Except Engines, maintain, diagnose, and repair mobile heavy equipment such as excavators and loaders. They specialize in hydraulic, drivetrain, electrical, and chassis faults and perform field emergency repairs and maintenance at worksites or in shops.
career_ai_description_block.heading: A diagnostic scanner can read a fault code in seconds, but an experienced mechanic still has to feel whether a hydraulic line is leaking and listen for whether a noise sounds right.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 诊断仪能秒读故障码，但那根液压管漏不漏、那声异响正不正，还得老师傅的耳朵和手去定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年移动重型设备机械师在岗约 18.87 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 19.96 万人，净增约 1.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.65 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.40 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代重型设备机械师，但会辅助诊断。诊断仪、远程读码与维修知识库把常规排查提速，机械师从「找故障」挪向「修复杂液压电控、现场救急、带学徒」。真正被挤掉的是只会换件的初级工，懂电控会判断的人更值钱。

液压图智能检索
维修记录结构化
培训模拟拆装
ai_s3_list: 复杂液压判断：靠经验。
工地救急：靠应变。
拆装手感：靠练。
异响辨别：靠耳。
带教把关：靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的动手区——诊断被辅助，但拆装、抢修与经验判断仍牢牢在人手里。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：被加速的是「常规读码与保养提醒」，不是「工地救急与复杂液压维修」的岗位。有电控诊断力、能现场扛事的机械师，反而更稳。怕的是只会换件、不懂电路的初级工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职高选工程机械或汽修，在校多摸诊断仪和电路。AI 时代纯机械在缩，早点补电控。
从「换件」升级成「读码 + 修电控」，学诊断软件，争取当站长或带学徒。
突出修过哪些机型、会不会诊断仪。设备商看重稳和能扛项目。
选人别只看力气，要看会不会读码修电控。能现场救急的老师傅，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 设备电子化，电控检修吃香。
远程诊断与知识库普及。
懂液压电控的复合机械师更稳。

body: 移动重型设备机械师（不含发动机）维护、诊断与修理挖掘机、装载机等移动重型设备，专攻液压、传动、电气与底盘故障，并在工地或车间完成现场抢修与保养。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 诊断仪能秒读故障码，但那根液压管漏不漏、那声异响正不正，还得老师傅的耳朵和手去定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can verify information automatically, but clerks still decide how to handle difficult cases, uphold compliance, and answer customers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 38,900 New Accounts Clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 33,800 by 2034, a net loss of about 5,100 jobs, with approximately 2,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $46,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace New Accounts Clerks, but it will take over standard account opening. OCR and automated due diligence accelerate routine applications, shifting clerks from data entry toward difficult-case assessment, compliance oversight, and customer communication. Pure data-entry work faces displacement, while people who understand rules and can resolve issues are more secure.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent identification of difficult cases
Intelligent risk alerts
Intelligent rule recommendations
Smart client reminders
ai_s3_list: Difficult-case assessment: people judge what is suspicious.
Compliance oversight: people enforce the bottom line.
Customer communication: people answer questions.
Risk identification: people identify concerns.
Rule interpretation: people provide consistent explanations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high exposure range. Systems accelerate parts of the workflow, but people still have an essential role where judgment and accountability are required.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Entering standard information is being replaced, not difficult-case assessment and compliance roles. People with strong command of rules who can resolve issues become scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in finance, develop strong rule and systems knowledge. Pure data entry is shrinking in the AI era, so build assessment skills early.
Advance from data entry to due diligence and compliance, and learn rules and communication.
Highlight zero-error performance and difficult cases. Institutions value consistency and accuracy.
When hiring, look beyond speed to attention to detail and compliance awareness. Core staff deserve responsibility for difficult accounts.

ai_s7_trends: As automated account opening spreads, data-entry work is shrinking.
Difficult-case assessment creates opportunities.
Clerks who can resolve issues have greater job stability.

body: New Accounts Clerks lead account opening and review, coordinating identity, eligibility, and systems. They apply regulatory checks and communication skills to complete due diligence and deliver compliant account opening.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can verify information automatically, but clerks still decide how to handle difficult cases, uphold compliance, and answer customers.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代新账户文员，但会接管标准开户。OCR 与自动尽调把常规开户外速，文员从「录资料」挪向「疑难研判、合规把关、客户沟通」。真正被挤掉的是纯录单，懂规则、能处置的人更稳。
ai_s2_accel: 疑难智能识别
风险智能预警
规则智能推
客户智能提醒
ai_s3_list: 疑难研判：可疑靠人判。
合规把关：底线靠人。
客户沟通：疑问靠人答。
风险识别：疑点靠人。
规则解释：口径靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「录标准资料」动作，不是「疑难研判与合规」的岗位。有规则力、能处置的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

从「录单」升级成「尽调 + 合规」，学规则与沟通。
突出零差错与疑难案，机构看重稳和准。
选人别只看快，看细心和合规意识，骨干值得给疑难户。

ai_s7_trends: 自动开户普及，录单缩。
疑难研判带来机会。
能处置的文员更稳。

body: 新账户文员主导账户的开立与审核，统筹身份、资质与系统，运用核规与沟通手段，完成尽调并推进合规开户落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动核，但疑难怎么判、合规怎么守、客户怎么答，还是文员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Software can model toolpaths, but patternmakers still decide how to adjust complex surfaces and whether prototypes are accurate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 1,600 metal and plastic patternmakers were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to fall to 1,200, a net decrease of about 400 jobs, with about 100 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $54,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace patternmakers, but it will reduce modeling tasks. CAD/CAM accelerates modeling and toolpath generation, shifting patternmakers from drawing toward complex-part adjustment, prototype interpretation, and precision control. Workers who only model from drawings face displacement, while those who can adjust and evaluate parts become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Smart tolerance recommendations
Trial-cut parameter optimization
Deviation alerts
Pattern-correction recommendations
ai_s3_list: Complex adjustment: people handle curved surfaces.
Prototype interpretation: people provide tactile judgment.
Pattern repair and correction: people provide experience.
Precision control: people apply standards.
Process tradeoffs: people exercise judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure in manufacturing. Systems accelerate modeling and toolpaths, but people remain essential for adjustment and interpretation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Modeling directly from drawings is being replaced, not roles that make complex parts accurate. Patternmakers who can adjust equipment and interpret precision become scarcer as productivity improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin with machining at a technical school and develop drawing-reading and tactile skills. Pure modeling is shrinking in the AI era, so practice adjustment early.
Advance from drawing to complex-part adjustment plus prototype interpretation, and pursue precision work.
Highlight precision-part experience and drawing-reading ability, specifying the materials you have worked with.
Do not assess candidates by software skills alone. Evaluate tactile skill and interpretation. Core workers who can make complex parts accurately deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: As CAD/CAM spreads, modeling work shrinks.
Complex-part adjustment remains essential.
Patternmakers who can interpret results are in greater demand.

body: Metal and plastic patternmakers create molds, patterns, and gauges from engineering drawings. They coordinate marking, carving, adjustment, and inspection to ensure the precision and consistency of mass-produced parts.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Software can model toolpaths, but patternmakers still decide how to adjust complex surfaces and whether prototypes are accurate.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代制版工，但会压缩建模动作。CAD/CAM 把建模和刀路提速，制版工从画图挪向复杂件调试、样件判读与精度把控。真正被挤掉的是只照图建模的，会调试能判读的人更值钱。

精度把控：标准靠人。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是照图建模动作，不是把复杂件做准的岗位。会调试、能判读精度的制版工，反而随提效更稀缺。

career_ai_description_block.heading: 软件能建模出刀路，但复杂曲面怎么调、样件准不准，还是制版工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can monitor equipment and optimize stockpile scheduling, but quarry rock splitters still judge where to make the cut and whether each block meets specifications.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 3,200 quarry rock splitters were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 3,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with approximately 400 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $47,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace quarry rock splitters, but it will change how they work. Systems can handle equipment monitoring, production scheduling, and stockpile management, shifting workers from memorizing workflows and waiting for assignments to operating equipment, reading stone grain, and protecting safety. Judgment about rock and disciplined execution of safety procedures are the truly scarce skills.
ai_s2_accel: Smart equipment monitoring and alerts
AI-assisted recognition of rock grain and fractures
Smart safety monitoring for slopes, dust, and equipment
Automated loading and stacking equipment
ai_s2_auto: Partial automation of cutting and splitting equipment
ai_s3_list: Grain and fracture judgment: knowing where to cut for a clean split without waste takes years of practice.
Equipment feel: the operator's hands determine how the same machine performs.
Safety judgment: workers must immediately notice loose slopes and unusual equipment noises.
On-site response: jammed blocks and equipment failures require decisive action.
Endurance and responsibility: completing work properly in harsh conditions depends on professionalism.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 means that systems are optimizing management and monitoring, but splitting itself combines heavy physical labor with equipment operation, limiting automation-based replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low risk does not mean no change. Mechanized equipment has already replaced substantial manual labor, leaving value in equipment operation + on-site judgment + safety execution. The industry's real risks are not AI but tighter environmental policies and mining rights.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you are considering quarrying or mining, pursue equipment operation and technical work rather than staying in a purely manual role. Earn relevant equipment-operation and safety credentials and advance toward loader or excavator operation for substantially better income and stability.

Learn several types of equipment and safety skills, and advance toward equipment operator or crew lead roles. Safety awareness and technical credentials are the most valuable investments in this field, and skilled compliant workers are more secure when environmental rules tighten.

Quick entry with no educational barrier is an advantage, but verify that the mine is legitimate and invests in safety. Master equipment operation and safety procedures, then broaden your options from quarrying into civil construction and mining trades.

Invest properly in safety training for rock splitters and maintain equipment regularly. Provide strong protective gear and smart monitoring systems. Retaining workers through a safety culture costs less than repeatedly recruiting replacements.

ai_s7_trends: Mechanization and automation are spreading, steadily reducing purely manual work.
Safety and environmental compliance are tightening, making smart monitoring standard at quarries.
Environmental and mining-rights policies are concentrating jobs in formal, technical operations.

body: Quarry rock splitters divide extracted rock into blocks of specified dimensions at quarries or mines, operate cutting and splitting equipment, and assist with block organization, handling, and safe operations.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can monitor equipment and optimize stockpile scheduling, but quarry rock splitters still judge where to make the cut and whether each block meets specifications.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能监控设备状态、优化料堆调度，但「这块石头该从哪下刀、尺寸合不合规格」，还得劈裂工在现场判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年岩石劈裂工、采石场在岗约 0.32 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.34 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.04 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.75 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代岩石劈裂工，但会改变工作方式。设备状态监控、排产调度、料堆管理都能交给系统，工人的时间从「记流程、等安排」挪向「操作设备、判断纹路、守安全」。真正稀缺的，是对岩石的判断力和对安全规程的执行力。
ai_s2_accel: 设备状态的智能监控与预警
AI 辅助的岩石纹理与裂隙识别
安全监测（边坡、粉尘、设备）智能化
自动化装载与码放设备
ai_s2_auto: 切割与劈裂设备的部分自动化
料堆与库存的数字化管理
作业记录与工时数字化
ai_s3_list: 纹路与裂隙判断：从哪下刀分得开、不浪费，是长期练出来的眼力。
设备手感：同样的机器，操作差异在手上。
安全判断：边坡松了、设备异响，要第一时间警觉。
现场应变：料块卡住、设备故障，处理要果断。
吃苦与责任心：恶劣环境下把活干利索，靠的是职业素养。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这行的管理和监控环节正被系统优化，但劈裂作业本身是重体力加设备操作，自动化替代有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低风险不等于没变化：机械化设备已经替代了大量人工作业，剩下的岗位价值在「设备操作 + 现场判断 + 安全执行」。这个行业真正的风险不是 AI，而是环保政策和矿权收紧。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 如果考虑进入采石和矿业，走设备操作和技术路线，别停在纯体力岗。考取相关设备操作和安全证书，往装载机、挖掘机操作手方向发展，收入和稳定性都好很多。
多学几种设备和安全技能，往设备操作手和班组骨干走。安全意识和技术证书是这行最值钱的积累，环保收紧时，合规熟练工更稳。
没有学历门槛、入职快是优势，但要确认矿场的正规性和安全投入。把设备操作学熟、安全规程记牢，再从采石转到土建和矿业更宽的工种。
劈裂工的安全培训要舍得投入，设备要定期维护。给工人配好防护和智能监控设备，用安全文化留人，比不断招新人划算。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 纹理分析、劈裂方案建议

ai_s7_trends: 机械化和自动化设备普及，纯人工作业持续减少。
安全与环保合规趋严，智能监控成为采场标配。
环保与矿权政策影响下，岗位向正规化、技术化集中。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: CRM can schedule visits automatically and AI can prepare quotes, but sales representatives still build the trust behind a promise to guarantee delivery and handle last-minute price negotiations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,310,500 wholesale and manufacturing sales representatives for nontechnical products were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 1,314,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,400 jobs, with approximately 114,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $66,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace wholesale and manufacturing sales representatives, but it will accelerate lead generation and quoting. CRM, AI prospect scoring, and automated quotes speed up front-end work, shifting representatives from finding customers to relationship management, complex negotiations, and delivery accountability. Lower-level lead work and standard quotes face displacement, while people who understand customers and close deals become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Customer profiles and recommendations
Smart competitor-price comparisons
Sales forecasting assistance
Sales-script and email generation
ai_s2_auto: CRM automatically schedules visits and renewals
ai_s3_list: Relationship management: people cultivate trust.
Complex negotiations: people bargain over price.
Delivery accountability: people make the commitment.
On-site closing: people secure the final agreement.
Key-account strategy: people set the pace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates medium-high AI exposure in lead generation. Systems accelerate prospecting and quoting, but people retain an essential role in relationship management and negotiations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is lower-level lead work and standard quotes, not customer management. People who understand others and close deals become even scarcer as productivity rises. Salespeople who only send mass quotes face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in business or marketing and practice communication and data skills while in school. Standard quoting is shrinking in the AI era, so develop relationship skills early.
Advance from chasing orders to customer management + strategy. Learn CRM and forecasting, and work toward regional responsibility.
Highlight performance and renewal cases, and specify the industries you have served. Companies value reliability and execution.
Do not select candidates only for conversational ability; assess whether they understand customers. Salespeople who cultivate accounts are worth high commissions.

ai_s7_trends: CRM and AI raise efficiency, reducing lead work.
Flatter channels force stronger account management.
Salespeople who understand customers and close deals are scarcer.

body: Wholesale and manufacturing sales representatives for nontechnical and nonscientific products sell everyday, industrial, and consumer goods to businesses. They develop and maintain accounts, quote and negotiate, and follow delivery and collections, connecting factory capacity to market demand.
career_ai_description_block.heading: CRM can schedule visits automatically and AI can prepare quotes, but sales representatives still build the trust behind a promise to guarantee delivery and handle last-minute price negotiations.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: CRM 能自动排拜访、AI 能出报价，但那句「交期我给你兜底」的信任、最后一刻的砍价，还是销售代表的嘴定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年销售代表、批发制造、产品在岗约 131.05 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 131.49 万人，净增约 0.44 万个岗位，年均产生约 11.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.68 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代批发制造销售代表，但会加速线索与报价。CRM、AI 潜客评分和自动报价把前端提速，代表从「找客户」挪向「关系经营、复杂谈判、交付兜底」。真正被挤掉的是低阶线索与标准报价，懂客户能成交的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 客户画像与推荐
竞品价格智能比对
成交预测辅助
话术与邮件生成
ai_s3_list: 关系经营：信任靠人养。
复杂谈判：砍价靠人。
交付兜底：承诺靠人。
现场成交：临门靠人。
大客户策略：节奏靠人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的线索区——挖掘与报价被系统加速，但经营与谈判还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「低阶线索与标准报价」动作，不是「客户经营」的岗位。懂人、能成交的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会群发报价的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 商贸/市场打底，在校多练沟通与数据。AI 时代标准报价在缩，早点练关系。
从「跑单」升级成「做客户经营 + 策略」，学 CRM 与预测，争取管区域。
突出业绩与续约案例，写清跟过哪些行业。企业看重稳和能打。
选人别只看会聊，要看懂不懂客户。能经营的销售，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: CRM 与 AI 提效，线索缩。
渠道扁平逼经营。
懂客户能成交的更缺。

body: 批发与制造销售代表（非技术科学产品）面向企业客户销售日用、工业与消费类货品，开发维护客户、报价谈判、跟进交付与回款，是工厂产能对接市场的销售前端。
career_ai_description_block.heading: CRM 能自动排拜访、AI 能出报价，但那句「交期我给你兜底」的信任、最后一刻的砍价，还是销售代表的嘴定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can grade work and create teaching materials, but teacher assistants still manage classroom order and provide individual support.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 1,422,800 teacher assistants, excluding postsecondary, were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 1,401,700 by 2034, a net decrease of about 21,100 jobs, with about 170,400 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $35,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace teacher assistants, but it will reduce administrative tasks. AI accelerates grading and teaching-material generation, shifting assistants from marking assignments toward classroom order, individual tutoring, and student trust. People who only grade work face displacement, while those who can guide and observe students become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Student learning analysis prompts
Tutoring pathway recommendations
Individual plan recommendations
Family-school communication templates
ai_s3_list: Classroom order: people manage the rhythm.
Individual tutoring: patience relies on people.
Teacher-student trust depends on human relationships.
Observation and judgment: human insight matters.
Emotional reassurance: genuine care relies on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in a moderately AI-exposed area of education. Systems accelerate grading and teaching materials, but people retain an essential role in classroom order and tutoring.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is grading assignments, not the role that supports the classroom. Assistants who can guide people and observe students become scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin with a teaching assistant internship and practice patience and observation. Pure grading is shrinking in the AI era, so develop tutoring skills early.
Advance from grading assignments to individual tutoring plus classroom management and work toward becoming a licensed teacher.
Highlight classroom and tutoring examples and specify the grade levels you have supported.
When hiring, look beyond education and assess patience. Core assistants who can keep a classroom functioning deserve stable positions.

ai_s7_trends: Grading and teaching-material generation become automated, reducing administrative work.
Demand for small classes and special education increases.
People skilled in individual tutoring are in greater demand.

body: Teacher assistants support lead teachers by helping deliver instruction, maintain classroom order, tutor students, prepare teaching aids, and grade assignments, enabling individualized learning and smooth classroom operations.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can grade work and create teaching materials, but teacher assistants still manage classroom order and provide individual support.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能批改出课件，但课堂秩序和个别辅导，还是助理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教师助理（不含高等教育）在岗约 142.28 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 140.17 万人，岗位净减约 2.11 万个，年均产生约 17.04 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.52 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代教师助理，但会压缩事务动作。批改和课件生成被 AI 加速，助理从改作业挪向课堂秩序、个别辅导与学生信任。真正被挤掉的是只改作业的，会带人能观察的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 学情分析提示
辅导路径推荐
个别计划建议
家校沟通模板
ai_s3_list: 课堂秩序：节奏靠人。
个别辅导：耐心靠人。
师生信任：关系靠人。
观察判断：眼光靠人。
情绪安抚：用心靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的教学区——批改课件被系统加速，但秩序和辅导还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是改作业动作，不是托住课堂的岗位。会带人、能观察学生的助理，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从助教实习起，多练耐心和观察，AI 时代纯批改在缩，早点练辅导。
从改作业升级成个别辅导加课堂管理，争取转正式教师。
突出带班和辅导案例，写清跟过哪些学段。
选人别只看学历，要看耐不耐得住。能托住课堂的骨干值得给稳定岗。

ai_s7_trends: 批改课件自动化，事务缩。
小班与特教需求增。
会个别辅导的更抢手。

body: 教师助理协助主讲教师开展教学，统筹课堂秩序、学生辅导、教具准备与作业批改，支持学生个别化学习与课堂顺畅运转。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能批改出课件，但课堂秩序和个别辅导，还是助理定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI outbound-calling robots can place ten thousand calls a day, but a human still has to judge that hint of hesitation in someone's voice and decide whether to press once more.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 67,400 telemarketers were employed in 2024, with employment projected to fall to 52,500 by 2034, a net loss of about 14,900 jobs. The occupation generates about 6,500 openings annually, and median annual pay was approximately $34,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: Telemarketers are among the occupations most directly affected by AI. AI outbound calling, intelligent voice systems, and automated screening have already taken over much standardized calling, and telemarketing jobs for simple products are shrinking. Yet high-value, complex sales in financial products, B2B services, and health-related offerings still require people to build trust, handle objections, and adapt in the moment, abilities AI voice systems cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI customer profiling and intent prediction
Script recommendations and real-time prompts
Intelligent quality checks and call-recording analysis
Coordinate multiple outreach channels (WeCom + phone)
ai_s2_auto: Automate outbound dialing and number screening
AI calling robots handle simple calls
Automatically enter call records and customer information
Automate lead assignment and follow-up reminders
ai_s3_list: Tone assessment: hear intent in the other person's voice.
Objection handling: turn 'I don't need it' into 'I'll think about it.'
Trust building: earn someone's trust in thirty minutes.
Improvisation: perform authentically beyond the script.
Emotional resilience: make another call after one hundred rejections.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means the process side of telemarketing is already deeply transformed by AI: dialing, screening, recordkeeping, and simple conversations can all be delegated to machines. But closing a sale still depends on trust, objection handling, and improvisation, where AI voice systems remain far behind. A score of 6 means low-end telemarketing is at risk while high-end telemarketing is becoming more valuable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Do not get stuck in a volume game. Move toward high-ticket, complex products, use AI for customer profiling and intent prediction, and close sales through human trust and adaptability. That is the right way to stay ahead of AI.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Telemarketing is not a career young people should remain in indefinitely, but it can be a bridge for developing communication skills. Work for a year to strengthen expression and resilience, then move into field sales, channel sales, or sales operations. Never mistake base salary plus commission for guaranteed income.

Do not panic when AI takes over volume work. Shift toward high-value product sales and customer operations, use new channels such as WeCom and livestreaming, and build your own customer relationships instead of relying on company call lists.

It is easy to enter telemarketing and not difficult to leave. The communication skills and resilience it develops transfer well to B2B sales, customer service management, or sales operations after a year. Prepare an interview story about the hardest deal you ever closed.

High turnover is normal in telemarketing. Retention depends on a clear commission structure and career path. Use AI calling to filter leads and let people handle high-value calls, and team productivity can improve.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated outbound calls and number management

ai_s7_trends: AI outbound calling and intelligent customer service are taking over simple calls, shrinking high-volume telemarketing.
Telemarketing is shifting toward high-value, multichannel sales and private-domain customer operations.
The phone is only the starting point as telemarketers evolve into omnichannel sales operators.

body: Telemarketers promote products or services to prospective customers by phone. They screen customers, explain products, handle objections, close orders, and conduct follow-up, serving as the sales executors for the telephone channel.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI outbound-calling robots can place ten thousand calls a day, but a human still has to judge that hint of hesitation in someone's voice and decide whether to press once more.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 外呼机器人一天能打一万通电话，但「对方语气里那点犹豫，要不要再追一句」——这个分寸，还得真人来拿。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电话销售员在岗约 6.74 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.25 万人，岗位净减约 1.49 万个，年均产生约 0.65 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.44 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: 电话销售员是被 AI 冲击最直接的岗位之一：AI 外呼、智能语音、自动筛选已经把大量标准化外呼接管，简单产品的电销岗位在收缩。但高价值、高复杂度的销售——金融产品、B2B 服务、大健康——仍然需要真人建立信任、处理异议、临场应变，这些是 AI 语音替代不了的。
ai_s2_accel: AI 客户画像与意向预测
话术推荐与实时提示
智能质检与分析通话录音
多触达渠道（企微+电话）联动
ai_s2_auto: 外呼拨号与号码筛选自动化
AI 外呼机器人承接简单话务
通话记录与客户信息自动录入
线索分配与跟进提醒自动化
ai_s3_list: 语气判断：从对方的声音里听出意向。
异议处理：把「不需要」聊成「再想想」。
信任建立：三十分钟让人信你。
临场应变：话术之外的真实发挥。
情绪韧性：被拒一百次还能再打。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明电销的「流程面」已经深度 AI 化：拨号、筛选、记录、简单对话都能交给机器；但成交依赖的信任、异议处理和临场应变，AI 语音还差得远。6 分意味着「低端电销危险，高端电销更值钱」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 别在「量的游戏」里耗着：往高客单价、复杂产品走，把 AI 当辅助（客户画像、意向预测），用真人的信任和应变成交——这才是躲开 AI 的正确姿势。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 电销不是孩子该长期待的行业，但可以是练沟通的过渡：年轻人可以先干一年磨炼表达和抗压，然后转面销、渠道或销售运营；千万别把「底薪+提成」听成「保证收入」。
别被 AI 抢走「量的活」就慌：往高价值产品销售和客户运营转，把企微、直播等新渠道用起来；沉淀自己的客户资源，比依赖公司名单强得多。
转进来容易，转出去也不难：电销练出的沟通和抗压是通用能力，做满一年再转 B2B 销售、客服管理或销售运营都顺；面试时准备好「你成交过的最难一单」的故事。
电销流失率高是常态，留人靠「清晰的提成制度和成长通道」；把 AI 外呼用于过滤线索，让真人打高价值电话，团队产出反而更高。

ai_s7_trends: AI 外呼与智能客服接管简单话务，量贩电销收缩。
电销向高价值、多触达、私域运营转型。
电话只是起点，电销员升级为全渠道销售运营。

body: 电话销售员（Telemarketers）通过电话向潜在客户推介产品或服务，负责客户筛选、产品讲解、异议处理、促成订单与后续跟进，是电话渠道的销售执行者。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can predict a yarn break from tension data before it happens, but people at the machines still perform the quick manual work of changing yarn, joining ends, and doffing packages.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 21,700 textile machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed in 2024, projected to decrease to 19,800 by 2034, a net loss of about 1,900 jobs, with about 2,500 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $37,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace textile operators all at once, but it will gradually take over monitoring and recordkeeping. Online inspection systems monitor yarn tension and quality in real time, while automatic winding machines join ends, doff packages, and change yarn. Operators are shifting from pure machine watching toward equipment management, data monitoring, and exception handling. People who perform only mechanical repetition and refuse to learn new equipment face the greatest risk.
ai_s2_accel: MES systems integrate production plans, output, and quality data
Predictive maintenance identifies equipment service timing
Intelligent spinning systems automatically optimize process parameters
Robotic material handling and packaging reduce repetitive labor
ai_s2_auto: Online inspection systems automatically monitor yarn tension and breaks
Automatic winding machines join ends, doff packages, and change yarn
Automatic production-data collection and report generation
ai_s3_list: Exception handling: Rapid on-site response to broken ends, tangled yarn, and clogged tubes.
Machine-adjustment experience: A practical feel for process parameters across yarn types.
Quality judgment: Assess yarn quality by touch and appearance.
Maintenance awareness: Resolve small faults immediately to avoid production delays.
Multi-machine coordination: Manage several machines simultaneously.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means automation is consuming repetitive actions, but skilled workers remain essential for exception handling, machine adjustment, and quality judgment. The score is not higher because production itself is shifting toward automated lines, making the next few years the operators' transition window.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean no change. Intelligent winding and online inspection are already spreading. Operators who interpret MES data, adjust automatic winding machines, and understand basic maintenance are in greater demand and earn more at highly automated new plants.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Traditional machine tending is not a strong choice, but students can study textile engineering or mechatronics and pursue intelligent textile production. People with limited education should earn an automated-equipment operation credential and move toward newer factories.

Learn new equipment early, including automatic winding, online inspection, and MES operation. Transition toward equipment maintenance, repair, or production-team leadership rather than remaining comfortable with only joining yarn ends.

People without textile experience should prioritize newer, highly automated factories where learning is faster. Those with maintenance or electromechanical backgrounds have better prospects entering through equipment maintenance than machine tending.
When hiring for new lines, look beyond fast hands to people who read data, handle anomalies, and want to learn equipment. Retraining experienced staff costs less than continually hiring replacements.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic joining, doffing, and yarn changes
Real-time yarn tension and appearance inspection
Integrated output, quality, and planning data
Automatic adjustment of twist, tension, and other parameters

ai_s7_trends: Automated winding and online inspection are spreading widely, rapidly reducing purely manual machine-tending roles.
Intelligent spinning factories have rising demand for versatile operators who understand equipment and data.
Capacity is moving toward intelligent production and lower-cost regions, shifting operators toward equipment maintenance and line management.

body: Textile winding and twisting machine operators operate and monitor winding, twisting, doubling, and drawing machines. They complete yarn winding, twisting, and drawing processes and perform quality inspections and equipment maintenance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在纱线断掉之前从张力数据里预判出来，但换纱、接头、落筒这些手上的快动作，还是得靠守在机台边的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年纺织、机器铺设工、操作员、看护员在岗约 2.17 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.98 万人，岗位净减约 0.19 万个，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会一下子取代纺织操作工，但会逐步接管「盯」和「记」：在线检测系统能实时监控纱线张力与质量，自动络筒机能自己接头落筒，操作工的角色从「纯看车」变成「管设备、看数据、处理异常」。真正危险的是只会机械重复、不学新设备的那批人。
ai_s2_accel: MES 系统把生产计划、产量与质量数据打通
预测性维护提示设备保养时机
智能纺纱系统自动优化工艺参数
机器人辅助搬运与包装减少重复劳动
ai_s2_auto: 在线检测系统自动监控纱线张力与断头
自动络筒机实现自动接头、落筒与换纱
生产数据自动采集与报表生成
设备运行状态自动监测与告警
ai_s3_list: 异常处理：断头、缠纱、堵管的现场快速处置。
调机经验：不同纱线品种的工艺参数手感。
质量判断：凭触感与外观判断纱线是否合格。
设备维护意识：小故障当场处理，不误产线。
多机台协调：同时看好几台机器的调度能力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的重复动作正在被自动化蚕食，但「异常处置 + 调机 + 质量判断」仍需熟练工；评分不会太高是因为岗位本身在向自动化产线转移，操作工的转型窗口就在这几年。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：智能络筒和在线检测已经在普及，会看 MES 数据、会调自动络筒机、懂一点设备维护的操作工，在自动化程度高的新厂里反而更抢手、收入更高。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 传统看车工不是好选择，但可以让孩子学纺织工程或机电一体化，走智能纺织产线方向。学历不高就去考个自动化设备操作类证书，往新厂走。
趁早学新设备：自动络筒、在线检测、MES 操作。往保全工、设备维修、产线班组长方向转，别停在「只会接头」的舒适区。
没有纺织经验想入行，优先选自动化程度高的新工厂，学得也快。有维修或机电背景的，从设备维护切入比从挡车工做起更有前途。
新产线招人别只看「手快」，要招会看数据、能处理异常、愿意学设备的人；老员工组织转岗培训，比一直招新人划算。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 纱线张力与外观实时检测
产量、质量、计划数据打通
自动调整捻度张力等参数
提前预警设备保养时机
纱筒搬运与包装自动化

ai_s7_trends: 自动化络筒与在线检测大面积普及，纯人工看车岗位快速收缩。
智能纺纱工厂对「会设备、看数据」的复合型操作工需求上升。
产能向智能化与低成本地区转移，操作工向设备保全与产线管理升级。

body: 纺织卷绕捻线操作工负责操作与看护络筒机、捻线机、并纱机、拉伸机等纺织设备，完成纱线卷绕、加捻、拉伸等工序，并进行质量检查与设备维护。
